records.originalTitleAtApproval: Not with Eyeservice — faithful work when no one is watching
records.displayTitle: Who Is Watching When You Work Alone?
records.promoDescription: This lesson shows how Yahweh sees every room, and why faithful work in small, unseen tasks matters to Him more than being noticed by others. It also looks honestly at sloth, the value of rest, and how to judge others by their fruit rather than by assumptions.

records.originalTitleAtApproval: Give Me This Mountain — Strength Kept for the Second Half
records.displayTitle: Is Your Strongest Season Still Ahead of You?
records.promoDescription: At eighty-five, Caleb asked Yahweh for the hard hill country he had been promised decades earlier, and this lesson looks at what his request teaches about setting aside gifts, waiting well, and passing faith to the next generation. records.promoDescription: This lesson uses a reported air traffic outage, kept at its weight as unconfirmed, to teach three habits for changing any system: test before you change, stop when the readings disagree, and write the plan before the trouble comes. It also shows how Yahweh holds together what no system people build can hold.
